scope: No full-case result or stability claim yet.
theorem: Every delivery-category route contains at least one of its delivery tasks; any subset containing that task is hit. Sufficient per-task correction inequalities therefore imply nonnegative reduced cost over every priced route. Pickup-only categories use mandatory pickup inequalities. Original capacity RHS determines objective terms.
numerical_policy: Clip reductions to original nonnegative multipliers, add a conservative fleet correction for residuals, preserve stronger old count repair.
validation: Independent repaired-price maximization LP checks objective, row bounds and sufficient inequalities. Complete pricing model matrices and repriced original bounds replayed for actual column CG and a fixed-price triangle example.
defaults: capacity_dual_repair False; count_dual_repair False; column_generation default preserved
failures: No capacity candidate solver/test failure observed so far. Earlier unrelated checker/driver failures retained in their original probes.
